m: सायाशन n. an ev˚-meal, ib.
सायाहन्, n. or साया˚ह्न, m. eventide, TBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.

सायारम्भ mfn. beginning in the ev˚, KātyŚr., Sch.
सायास mfn. beset with difficulties or trouble, Kathās.

m: 1. साय n. (prob. fr. √ सो See अवसाय, अवसान; but cf. 2. साय, col. 3) the close of day, evening (सायं-√ कृ, ‘to spend the evening, make a stay’), RV. &c. &c.
Evening personified (as a son of Puṣpārṇa and Doṣā or as a son of Dhātṛ and Kuhū), BhP.
साय [cf. accord. to some, Lat. sērus.]
सायं in comp. for सायम्, col. 3.
2. साय m. (fr. √ 2. सि; for 1. See col. 2) a missile, arrow (= सायक), L.
साय n. unloosing, unyoking, turning in RV. &c.
साय See s.v.
a: सायः — [सो-घञ्] 1 End, close, termination. --2 Close of day, evening. --3 An arrow. (साये ‘in the evening, at the close of the day.) --Comp. --अहन् m. (forming सायाह्नः) evening, evening time; Bv. 2. 157.

m: साय—धूर्त m. a rogue, cheat or deceiver in the form of ev˚, Naiṣ.
सायं—धृति f. = -होम, MW.
सायं—दोह m. milking the cows at evening, ev˚ milking or milk, ĀpŚr.
सायं—दोह—वत् ind., ib.
सायं—दुग्ध mfn. milked in the evening, ib.; ŚBr.
सायं—गृह mfn. = यत्र-स्˚, Prab.
सायं—गोष्ठ mfn. brought into the fold at ev˚, AitBr.
सायं—होम m. the ev˚ oblation, ĀśvŚr., Sch.

m: सायं—काल n. eventide, evening, Naiṣ., Sch.
सायं—कालिक (Vās., Sch.) or सायं—कालीन (Ragh., Sch.), mfn. belonging to evening, vespertine.
सायं—निवास m. ev˚ abode or resting-place, ib.
सायं—सूर्य m. the ev˚ sun, MBh.
सायं—सूर्˚योढ mfn. brought by the ev˚ sun (said of a guest), Mn. iii, 105.
सायं—संध्या f. the evening twilight, RTL. 407
सायं—संध्या—देवता f. ‘deity of the ev˚ t˚’, N. of Sarasvatī, L.
सायं—संध्या—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.

s: strI, (sAyaM sAyAhne yA sanDyA .) sAyaMkAlopAsyA devatA । sAyaMkAlakarttavyopAsanA । sAyaMsanDyopAsanAkAlaSca । tatpramARaM sanDyASabde drazwavyam । paScimA sanDyA । tasyA utpattiryaTA, -- mArkaRqeya uvAca । “nArAyaRaH svayaM sanDyAM pasparSATAgrapARinA । tataH puroqASamayaM tacCarIramaBUt kzaRAt ॥ mahAmunermmahAyajYe tasmin viSvopakAriRi । nAgniH kravyAdatAM yAtItyetadaTa taTA kftam ॥ evaM kftvA jagannATastatrEvAntaraDIyata । sanDyApyagacCadyatreje tatra meDAtiTirmuniH ॥ aTa vizRoH prasAdena kenApyanupalakzitA । praviveSa tadA yajYaM sanDyA meDAtiTermaneH ॥ vaSizWe na purA yA tu varRIBUtA tu sA sutA । upadizwA tapaScarttuM vacanAt paramezWinaH ॥ tameva kftvA manasi tapaScaryyopadeSakam । patitvena tadA sanDyA brAhmaRaM brahmacAriRam ॥ samidDe'gnO mahAyajYe muniBirnopalakzitA । tadA vizRoH prasAdena sA viveSa viDeH sutA ॥ tasyAH puroqASamayaM SarIraM tatkzaRAttataH । dagDaM puroqASaganDaM vyastArayadalakzitam ॥ vahnistasyAH SarIraM taddagDvA sUryyasya maRqale । SudDaM praveSayAmAsa vizRorevAjYayA punaH ॥ sUryyo dviDA viBajyATa tatSarIraM tadA raTe । svake saMsTApayAmAsa prItaye pitfdevayoH ॥ yadUrdDaBAgaM tasyAstu SarIrasya dvijottamAH । prAtaHsanDyABavat sA tu ahorAtrAdimaDyagA ॥ yacCezaBAgastasyAstu ahorAtrAntamaDyagA । sA sAyamaBavat sanDyA pitfprItipradA sadA ॥ sUryyodayAcca praTamaM yadA syAdaruRodayaH । prAtaHsanDyA tadodeti devAnAM prItikAriRI ॥ astaM gate tataH sUryye SoRapadmaniBA sadA । udeti sAyaMsanDyA sA pitFRAM modakAriRI ॥” iti SrIkAlikApurARe arunDatIjanmakaTane 22 aDyAyaH ॥

m: सायं—तूर्य n. drumming at ev˚, L.

a: सायंतन — a. (नी f.) Belonging to the evening, evening; सायंतने सवनकर्मणि संप्रवृत्ते Ś. 3. 27; अलिनारमतालिनी शिलींध्रे सह सायंतनदीपपादलाभे Śi. 6. 72.

m: सायं—यावन् mfn. going or coming in the evening, TBr.
सायणीय mfn. relating to or composed by Sāyaṇa
सायणीय n. a work of Sāyaṇa, Cat.

सायण m. (said to be a Drāviḍa word) N. of a learned Brāhman (also called Sāyaṇamādhava and Sāyaṇācārya; he was son of Māyaṇa, pupil of Viṣṇu Sarva-jña and of Śaṃkarānanda; and flourished under Bukka I of Vijaya-nagara or Vidyā-nagara [A.D. 1350-1379] and his successor Harihara, and died in 1387; of more than a hundred works attributed to him, among which are commentaries on nearly all parts of the Veda, some were carried out by his pupils, and some were written in conjunction with his brother Mādhavācārya or Vidyāraṇya-svāmin).
a: सायणः — N. of a very learned Brāhmaṇa supposed to have flourished about 1370 A. D.

m: सायण—माधवीय mfn. written or composed by Sāyaṇa-mādhava, Sarvad.
सायकाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to resemble arrows, represent the arrows of (comp.), Daś.
सायकायन m. patr. fr. सायक, ŚBr. (g. नडादि).
सायकायनिन् m. pl. the school of Sāyakāyana, ib.

सायक m. (in RV. also n.) a missile, arrow, RV. &c. &c.
सायक m. a symbolical expression for the number ‘five’ (from the 5 arrows of the god of love), Sāh.
a sword, MBh.; R.
the latitude of the sky, Gaṇit.
Saccharum Sara, L.
N. of a man, Pravar.

k.v: आकाशे त्रिदिवे नाको लोकस्तु भुवने जने। पद्ये यशसि च श्लोकः शरे खड्गे च सायकः॥
आकाशे त्रिदिवे नाको लोकस्तु भुवने जने। पद्ये यशसि च श्लोकः शरे खड्गे च सायकः॥

m: सायक—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of arrows, MBh.; Hariv.
सायक—प्रणुत्त (साय्˚), mfn. driven away or put to flight by arrows, AV.

सायक—पुङ्ख m. the feathered part of an arrow, Ragh.

m: सायम् (अम्), ind. in the evening, at eventide (सायं सायम्, ‘every evening’; see also below), RV.; &c.
सायम् ind. in comp.
a: सायम् — ind. In the evening; प्रयता प्रातरन्वेतु सायं प्रत्युद्व्रजेदपि R. 1. 90. --Comp. --कालः evening. --धृतिः f. the evening oblation. --मंडनं {1} sunset. {2} the sun. --संध्या {1} the evening twilight. {2} the evening prayer. {3} the goddess to be worshipped in the evening. ˚देवता N. of Sarasvatī.

k.v: प्रभातं च दिनान्ते तु सायं सन्ध्या पितृप्रसूः। प्राह्णापराह्णमध्याह्नास्त्रिसन्ध्यमथ शर्वरी॥
पुनरर्थेऽङ्ग निन्दायां दुष्ठु सुष्ठु प्रशंसने। सायं साये प्रगे प्रातः प्रभाते निकषान्तिके॥

m: सायम्—आश m. id., Kauś.
सायम्—आश—प्रातराश m. (only loc. ए), the ev˚ and morning m˚, Gobh.
सायम्—आहुति f. an ev˚ oblation, ŚBr.; GṛŚrS.
सायम्—भव m. becoming evening, growing dirk, AV.
सायम्—भोजन n. an evening meal, Kull. on Mn. iii, 105.
सायम्—औपासन-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
सायम्—अधिवास m. ‘evening decoration’, decorating an image of Durgā on the fifth day of the month Āśvina, MW.
साय—मण्डन n. ‘ev˚-ornament’, sunset, W.
सायम्—अशन n. an ev˚ meal, MaitrS.
सायम्—मन्त्र m. a Mantra to be used in the evening, Baudh.
सायम्—पोष m. food taken in the ev˚, ŚāṅkhBr.
सायम्—प्रातर् (सायम्-), ind. in the ev˚ and m˚ (also सायम् प्राशश्च), AV. &c. &c.
सायम्—प्रातर्—आशिन् mfn. eating (only) in the ev˚ and m˚, ŚBr.
सायम्—प्रातर्—आहुति f. du. ev˚ and m˚ oblation, KātyŚr.
सायम्—प्रातर्—औपासन-विधि m. N. of wk.
सायम्—प्रातर्—अग्निहोत्र-होम m. N. of wk.
सायम्—प्रातर्—अग्निहोत्र-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
सायम्—प्रातर्—दोह m. ev˚ and morning milking, ib.
सायम्—प्रातर्—होम m. du. ev˚ and m˚ oblation, Gobh. (also N. of wk.)
सायम्—प्रातर्—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of ev˚ and m˚, KāśīKh.
सायम्प्रातिक mfn. (fr. सायम्-प्रातर्) belonging to evening and morning, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 144, Vārtt. 5, Pat.
सायम्—उपासन-विधि m. N. of wk.
सायन mfn. proceeding in the way of an Ayana (q.v.), ŚāṅkhŚr.
connected with the word अयन, ib.
सायन n. (in astron.) with the precession or the longitude of a planet reckoned from the vernal equinoctial point, W.
a: सायनं — The longitude of a planet reckoned from the vernal equinoctial point.

m: सायन्तन mf(ई)n. relating to evening, vespertine, Kāv.; Pañcat.; ŚārṅgS.
सायन्तन—मल्लिका f. evening jasmine, Ragh.
सायन्तन—समय m. eventide, Pañcat.
सायतन mfn. together with the place of abode &c., TS.
साय—तरे ind. late in the evening, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 23, Vārtt. 1.
सायवस m. a patr. ŚBr.
सायिका (इका), f. a dagger, L.
the being or standing in regular order (= क्रम-स्थिति; prob. w.r. for शायिका), L.

सायोद्भिदुर mfn. expanding or blossoming in the evening, L.

सायुध mf(आ)n. furnished with arms, armed, MBh.
सायुध—प्रग्रह mfn. holding weapons in the hand, MW.

s: klI, (sayujo sahayogasya BAvaH । brAhmaRAditvAt zyaY .) sahayogaH । ekatvam । tattu paYcaDAmuktyantargatamuktiviSezaH । yaTA, -- “sAlokyasArzwisAmIpyasArUpyEkatvamapyuta । dIyamAnaM na gfhRanti vinA matsevanaM janAH ॥” iti SrIBAgavate । 3 । 29 । 13 ॥ “BaktAnAM nizkAmatAM kEmutikanyAyenAha । sAlokyaM mayA saha ekasmin loke vAsam । sArzwiM samAnESvaryyam । sAmIpyaM nikawavarttitvam । sArUpyaM samAnarUpatAm । ekatvaM sAyujyam । uta api dIyamAnamapi na gfhRanti kutastatkAmanA ityarTaH .” iti SrIDarasvAmI ॥ “ekatvaM BagavatsAyujyaM brahma sAyujyaYca । anayostallIlAtmakatvena tatsevanArTatvABAvAt grahaRAvaSyakatvameveti BAvaH .” iti kramaMsandarBaH ॥
v: na॰ saha yunakti--yuja--kvip sAdeSaH sayuN tasya BAvaH zyaY । 1 sahayoge paYcaviDamuktimaDye 2 ekatvarUpe muktiBede ca “sAlokyasArzwisAmIpyasArUpyEkatvamapyuta । dIyamAnaM na gfhRanti vinA matsevana janAH” BAga॰ 3 ska॰ 29 a॰ ।
m: सायुज्य n. (fr. स-युज्) intimate union, communion with (gen. loc. instr., or comp.)
identification, absorption (into the divine Essence; this is one of the four grades or states of Mukti cf. सालोक्य, RTL. 41), Kāṭh.; Br.; MBh. &c.
likeness, similarity, W.
a: सायुज्यं — 1 Intimate union, identification, absorption, especially into a deity (one of the four states of Mukti). --2 Similarity, likeness.

m: सायुज्य—मुक्ति f. emancipation consisting in the above absorption, Cat.
सायुज्य—ता f. (Hcat.) = prec.
सायुज्य—त्व n. (MaitrUp.) = prec.
साय्य m. a patr. (v.l. साप्य), RV. vi, 20, 6.
